result.topic_en: Integration of second-order differential equations: the cases d²z/dx² = function of (x,y) and d²z/dx² = P dz/dx + Q, followed by the Riccati-type equation a dy/dx = yy + x^n, reduced by the substitution y = -a dt/(t dx) to a linear second-order equation and solved by power series.
result.transcription:
Von $\left(\frac{ddz}{dx^2}\right) = \phi(x,y)$ ist das Integral
$z = \int dx \int P dx + x f:y + F y$

$\frac{ddz}{dx^2} = p\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + Q$ I: $z = \int e^{\int P dx} dx \int e^{-\int P dx} Q dx$
$+ f:y \int e^{\int P dx} dx + F:y$
ubi P et Q s. fctnes
ipsorum x, y.

$\frac{a dy}{dx^2} = yy + x^n$

[-...-] ...
sit $y = \frac{-a dt}{t dx}$ || $-\frac{aad^2t}{tdx^2} + \frac{aadt^2}{t^2dx^2} = \frac{+aadt^2}{t^2dx^2} + x^n$
$\frac{aad^2t}{dx^2} + tx^n = 0$
$t = A + Bx^{n+2} + Cx^{2n+4} \ldots$
$aa B.n+2.n+1 \atop + A$ | $+ aa C\, 2n+4.2n+3 \atop + B$ &c
$t = a\left(1 - \frac{aa}{n+1.n+2}x^{n+2} + \frac{a^4 x^{2n+4}}{n+1.n+2.2n+3.2n+4}\right.$ &c.$\left.\right)$
$+ B\left(x - \frac{aa}{n+2.n+3}x^{n+3} - \frac{a^4}{n+2.n+3.2n+4.2n+5}\right.$ &c$\left.\right)$
$y = \frac{[-\alpha a-] \frac{a^3x^{n+1}}{n+1} - \frac{a^5}{n+1.n+2.2n+3} \ldots + \mathfrak{A}(a - \frac{a^3}{n+2}x^{n+2})}{\left(1 - \frac{aa}{n+1.n+2}x^{n+2}\ldots\right) + \mathfrak{A}\left(x - \frac{aa}{n+2.n+3}x^{n+3}\ldots\right)}$
